query: SELECT LEFT(data, 7) as mes, empresaSlug, SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat5, COUNT(*) as dias FROM faturamentos WHERE data < '2026-03-01' AND CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0 GROUP BY LEFT(data, 7), empresaSlug ORDER BY mes DESC, empresaSlug LIMIT 20;
